Lovely view and nice menu, staff a bit surly
Feb 2024 • Friends
I came in here around 2pm with a friend. We wanted to sit outside so they found us a seat on the lower balcony, overlooking the river. It was lovely with some great river views.

They serve from the breakfast menu until 1430 but this had lots of choice and lots of things I consider as non breakfast. I had the beef stew and my friend had the seafood hotpot. Both were large and came with a big salad and bread roll. 

The food tasted lovely i thought and was prepared well. 

The staff seemed a bit surly and no one really smiled, they did their job but that was about it. 

Overall, I thought was good but staff need to improve their manner.
